title: Learning Adaptable Dexterous Skills via Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking
abstract: arXiv:2610.28628v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dexterous multi-finger hands hold promise to unlock diverse skills like functional grasps, in-hand reorientation, and dynamic handover that the human-designed world assumes, yet existing learning recipes force a trade-off. Goal-reaching reinforcement learning generalizes to arbitrary object poses but, lacking any human prior, converges to unnatural and unreliable finger strategies; motion tracking reproduces human-like behavior from a single clip but cannot deviate from it. We present AdaDex, a goal-conditioned RL framework that turns a single hand-object trajectory of a few seconds---from mocap data or HOI reconstruction from in-the-wild RGB(D) video---into an adaptable dexterous skill. translated_title: 通过混合灵巧模仿学习可适应的灵巧技能
translated_abstract: 灵巧多指手有望解锁人类设计的世界所依赖的多种技能，例如功能性抓取、手中重定向和动态交接，然而现有的学习方法迫使我们做出权衡：基于目标达成的强化学习虽然能泛化到任意物体姿态，但由于缺乏人类先验，会收敛到不自然且不可靠的手指策略；而运动追踪方法虽然能从单个片段中复现类人行为，却无法偏离该片段。我们提出了AdaDex，一个目标条件强化学习框架，它能将一段仅有几秒钟的手-物体轨迹——来自动作捕捉数据或从真实世界RGB(D)视频中进行人-物交互（HOI）重建——转化为可适应的灵巧技能。AdaDex的核心是混合灵巧模仿：一个共享策略在两类大规模并行环境群上进行训练：一类是使用密集运动追踪目标训练的运动追踪环境，用以从人类动
tldr: AdaDex提出混合灵巧模仿方法，通过在运动追踪环境和目标达成环境中联合训练共享策略，将几秒钟的手-物体轨迹转化为既保留人类先验又能泛化到任意物体姿态的可适应灵巧技能。
en_tdlr: AdaDex introduces Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking, which jointly trains a shared policy on motion tracking and goal-reaching environments to turn a few-second hand-object trajectory into an adaptable dexterous skill that retains human priors while generalizing to arbitrary object poses.
